source_refs.note: 'Selecting Features and Target Values' under topic 6.6, as printed (PDF 84, printed 80).

blocks.text: Features are input values used by the model. Target values are the outputs to be predicted. Correct feature selection improves learning. Unnecessary features can reduce accuracy. Features must be relevant to the problem. Target values must be clearly defined. Example: When predicting student marks, study hours would be the feature, and the target value would be the marks.
